id.label: Row ID
id.help: Database-generated UUID referenced by every Ailytics child table.

project_code.label: Project code
project_code.help: Unique human project identity; unlike sibling services, it is not the primary key.

company.label: Company
company.help: Operator-facing identity only; Ailytics runtime behavior does not read it.

enabled.label: Telegram intake enabled
enabled.help: Stops new Telegram alerts but does not prevent existing WhatsApp-linked issues from closing (INV-AIL-15).

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: Used for sheet timestamp rendering; only Asia/Singapore has been exercised.

telegram_chat_id.label: Telegram chat ID
telegram_chat_id.help: First half of the Telegram intake match; unknown onboarding values use an empty string (INV-AIL-09).

upstream_bot_username.label: Upstream bot username
upstream_bot_username.help: Case-insensitive intake identity with a leading @ ignored; paired uniquely with the chat ID (INV-AIL-09/16).

expected_chat_title.label: Expected chat title
expected_chat_title.help: Informational note only; it is never used to match Telegram intake.

spreadsheet_id.label: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheet_id.help: Workbook for both projections; the service account needs Editor access because tabs are created on demand (INV-AIL-07).

activity_history_tab.label: Activity history tab
activity_history_tab.help: Projection tab; write the live (CODE) CCTV History convention explicitly rather than relying on the legacy default (INV-AIL-08).

safety_sheet_tab.label: Safety sheet tab
safety_sheet_tab.help: Projection tab; write the live (CODE) CCTV Safety Sheet convention explicitly rather than relying on the legacy default (INV-AIL-08).

lambda_url_image.label: Send-document URL
lambda_url_image.help: Normal image endpoint. A Non-Compliant reply derives the companion /reply-document URL by replacing this final route segment.

reply_lambda_url.label: Reply-message URL
reply_lambda_url.help: Listener endpoint used for threaded WhatsApp replies.

instance_name.label: WhatsApp instance
instance_name.help: Listener instance; unknown onboarding values use an empty string rather than null (INV-AIL-09).

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Sending-account identifier; unknown onboarding values use an empty string rather than null (INV-AIL-09).

whatsapp_group_ids.label: WhatsApp groups
whatsapp_group_ids.help: Comma-separated destinations, trimmed and de-duplicated per send (INV-AIL-17).

forward_pending_to_whatsapp.label: Forward pending alerts
forward_pending_to_whatsapp.help: Gates only the delivery attempt; capture and history writes continue, and PENDING requires confirmed delivery (INV-AIL-14/19).

status_summary_enabled.label: Status summary enabled
status_summary_enabled.help: Allows project-local sheet counts to be sent; this is not an estate-wide aggregate (INV-AIL-18).

yesterday_summary_enabled.label: Yesterday summary enabled
yesterday_summary_enabled.help: Enables the hourly previous-local-day Ailytics findings summary route without changing the existing status summary behavior.

yesterday_summary_hour.label: Yesterday summary hour
yesterday_summary_hour.help: Local project hour from 0 to 23 at which the hourly route is allowed to send the previous day's summary.

yesterday_summary_group_ids.label: Yesterday summary WhatsApp groups
yesterday_summary_group_ids.help: Comma-separated dedicated Safety Inspection Summary WhatsApp group IDs; this does not reuse whatsapp_group_ids.

constraints.name: project_configs_telegram_chat_id_upstream_bot_username_key
constraints.help: Only one row may use a Telegram chat ID and bot-username pair, including a fully blank draft pair (INV-AIL-09).
